title: data-synthesizer
summary: A small personal project demonstrating how to generate a synthetic version of a Spotify tracks dataset, with a Jupyter notebook example and a general-purpose script. It runs SDV's SingleTablePreset synthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, load_csvs, and evaluate_quality/get_column_plot to fit, sample, and evaluate the synthetic data.
evidence: synth.py:1-8 imports SingleTablePreset, load_csvs, SingleTableMetadata, evaluate_quality from sdv and calls them on the spotify_tracks dataset
needs: SingleTablePreset's underlying synthesizer (FAST_ML/gaussian_copula) is inferred, not explicitly confirmed by class name in evidence
